text: Bought this keyboard used for 38 dollars. Knew that price doesn't buy perfection. It didn't. Spacebar rattles, not every press, but often enough that I notice it in the silence before I start writing. One key repeats too, will type a word and find a double letter in the middle. I reread everything before hitting send. Saved me from a few other mistakes, I think. Would rather the keyboard had not forced it. Asked seller what switches before buying, got answer a week later, too late. I'd already ordered it and started learning the feel. Why I keep it: comfort. I write long emails, sort of past the point where you stop paying attention to your hands. This one doesn't tire them. Keys have weight that I like. After an hour I'm still typing same pace. Thought about shipping back, kept it. Rattle is less annoying than packing a box.
